title: Science-1
blurb: Mechanics, relativity, thermodynamics and quantum, arranged as 12 endsem chapters. Each chapter has the ideas topic by topic, a section-by-section reference, and practice questions with worked solutions.

docs.title: Start here: the endsem map
docs.about: The 12 endsem topics, what each covers, slides, textbook sections and homework for every subtopic, and the video list

docs.title: Chapter 1: Scales, modelling and nonlinear dynamics
docs.about: Orders of magnitude, non-dimensionalisation, the logistic map, fixed points and stability, prey–predator

docs.title: Chapter 2: Newtonian mechanics of one particle and many
docs.about: Newton's laws, work–energy, conservation laws, oscillations, systems of particles, variable mass

docs.title: Chapter 3: Calculus of variations and Lagrangian mechanics
docs.about: Brachistochrone, Euler–Lagrange equation, generalised coordinates, constraints, symmetries

docs.title: Chapter 4: Hamiltonian dynamics and the two-body problem
docs.about: Hamilton's equations, phase space, Liouville, reduced mass, effective potential, Kepler orbits

docs.title: Chapter 5: Special relativity
docs.about: Postulates, Lorentz transformation, time dilation, length contraction, Doppler, relativistic momentum and energy

docs.title: Chapter 6: Thermodynamics I: gases and the first law
docs.about: Perfect and real gases, kinetic theory, work, heat, internal energy, enthalpy, heat capacities, Joule–Thomson, thermochemistry

docs.title: Chapter 7: Thermodynamics II: second law, entropy and free energy
docs.about: Cycles and engines, Carnot, Clausius inequality, entropy, free energies, Maxwell relations, phases

docs.title: Chapter 8: Particle properties of waves
docs.about: Blackbody radiation, photoelectric effect, X-rays, Compton scattering

docs.title: Chapter 9: Wave properties of particles
docs.about: de Broglie waves, Davisson–Germer, uncertainty principle, Bohr model, Franck–Hertz

docs.title: Chapter 10: Atomic structure
docs.about: Quantum numbers, spin, Zeeman effect, spin–orbit coupling, the periodic table

docs.title: Chapter 11: Quantum mechanics
docs.about: Schrödinger equation, operators, particle in a box, finite well, tunnelling, harmonic oscillator

docs.title: Chapter 12: Quantum theory of the hydrogen atom
docs.about: The hydrogen atom in the Schrödinger picture

docs.title: Practice: Mock endsem
docs.about: A 50-point, 120-minute paper across all 12 chapters, then the marking scheme, worked solutions and a score sheet by chapter

docs.title: Practice set: thermodynamics
docs.about: 42 mixed questions with worked solutions, from recall to numericals

docs.title: Thermodynamics cheat sheet
docs.about: Atkins 1A to 3B on a few pages, mapped to the slides

docs.title: Thermodynamics formula sheet
docs.about: Constants and every formula from 1A to 3B

docs.title: Thermodynamics definitions
docs.about: Every term to state precisely in an exam
